yes.0: I need you to slay #r50#k #r#o1210103#s#k, and bring back #b10#k #b#t4032137#s#k. There should be at least one real Doll mixed in that amount...
yes.1: You know where the Bubblings are, right? They must've stolen all of the real Dolls, then moved to Ellinia. Try looking for them on Chimney Tree road in Ellinia.
